high_level_description: The image shows a person standing in what appears to be an airport walkway or corridor. The individual is wearing a dark blue hoodie with yellow accents on the shoulders and sleeves, paired with dark jeans and white sneakers. They have a yellow backpack slung over one shoulder and are holding a book in their hands. The person is also wearing glasses and has short hair. In the background, there are several other individuals who seem to be waiting or walking through the corridor. Some of them are carrying bags, suggesting they might be travelers.
